changed.title: Find a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit under the ranked cyclic witness negation bound
changed.statement:
∃ (n w : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (q : Fin (2 ^ n)),
  let I := n * 2 ^ (w + 1)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (outBit : Fin n → Fin (I + C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧
    (∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let inputs := (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => List.ofFn (fun pat : Fin (2 ^ (w + 1)) =>
        table i (fun j => pat.val.testBit j.val)))).flatten
      let sols := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ n))).filter (fun z => ∀ i : Fin n,
        table i (fun j => z.val.testBit (n - 1 - ((i.val + j.val) % n))) = true)
      q.val < sols.card → ∃ z ∈ sols,
        (sols.filter (fun y => y.val < z.val)).card = q.val ∧
        ∀ pos : Fin n, (C.wires inputs).getD (outBit pos).val false =
          z.val.testBit (n - 1 - pos.val)) ∧
    ∃ k b : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ w + 1 ∧ k + b ≤ n ∧ q.val < 2 ^ (k + b) ∧
      2 ^ PEqualNP.NotBracket.notCount C <
        1 + ((n - b) / k) * (2 ^ k - 1) - q.val / 2 ^ b
changed.unlocks: tests the ranked-word NOT bound on all valid cyclic tables
changed.context: We hold no circuit below this bound. Test the free-tail charge with n=5, w=1, k=2, b=1 and q=3. The chain predicts that two NOT gates cannot suffice. Shared negations may serve output bits across blocks, but each valid rank must be returned on the same fixed wires on every raw table. Give a gate list and count each internal NOT once.
changed.sketch: We hold no circuit below this bound. Test the free-tail charge with n=5, w=1, k=2, b=1 and q=3. The chain predicts that two NOT gates cannot suffice. Shared negations may serve output bits across blocks, but each valid rank must be returned on the same fixed wires on every raw table. Give a gate list and count each internal NOT once.

changed.title: One shared set of parity checks recovers the hidden payload on both sides of a cyclic intersection encoding
changed.statement:
∀ (a b h s q : Nat) (hn : 0 < a+b), 0 < q → 0 < s → s ≤ h →
  q*h < a → (q+1)*h ≤ b →
  let n := a+b
  let M := q^2 * (2^s-1)^(2*(q-1)) * 2^(n-(2*q*s+(h-s)))
  let Word := Fin n → Bool
  let Pat := Fin (n-h) → Bool
  let Slot := Fin n × Pat
  let loc := fun k : Nat => (⟨k%n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let solutions := fun (tab : Slot → Bool) =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset Word).filter (fun x =>
      ∀ i : Fin n, tab (i,fun j => x (loc (i.val+j.val))) = true)
  ∃ (code : Fin M → Word) (base : Slot → Bool) (left right : Fin M → Slot),
    Function.Injective code ∧ Function.Injective left ∧ Function.Injective right ∧
    (∀ i, (left i).1.val < a ∧ a ≤ (right i).1.val ∧
      base (left i) = false ∧ base (right i) = false) ∧
    ∀ A B : Finset (Fin M), solutions (fun slot =>
      base slot || decide (slot ∈ A.image left) || decide (slot ∈ B.image right)) =
        (A ∩ B).image code
changed.unlocks: encodes two mask inputs on a cyclic table with a common collection of parity checks
changed.context: Give each tile s label bits. Require exactly one zero label per arc. Across all tiles require even parity in each of the h-s other columns. One guard sees every tile because the final h sites are reserved. Arc guards see their full arcs. Put each word's port just after its marked tile. Its window misses only that tile. The mark fixes its label and the shared checks recover its other bits. Count the marked sites, nonzero labels and free payload coordinates. A guarded word passes exactly its two switches.

The mark fixes its label and the shared checks recover its other bits. Count the marked sites, nonzero labels and free payload coordinates. A guarded word passes exactly its two switches.

changed.title: Coordinatewise gaps on unique intersections charge a sum of squared biases to the size of randomized rectangle partitions
changed.statement:
∀ (m T R Q a : Nat), 0 < T → 0 < R → 0 < Q → a ≤ Q →
  ∀ (b : Fin m → Nat), (∀ i, b i ≤ Q) →
  let W := Finset (Fin m)
  ∀ (label : Fin R → W → W → Fin T) (out : Fin R → Fin T → Bool),
    (∀ r x y x' y', label r x y = label r x' y' → label r x y' = label r x y) →
    let ones := fun x y : W => ((List.finRange R).filter (fun r => out r (label r x y))).length
    (∀ x y : W, Disjoint x y → Q*ones x y ≤ a*R) →
    (∀ (i : Fin m) (x y : W), x ∩ y = {i} → b i*R ≤ Q*ones x y) →
    2^(∑ i : Fin m, (b i-a)^2) ≤ T^(16*Q^2)
changed.unlocks: bounds the sum of squared success gaps across the possible unique intersection sites
changed.context: Assign each coordinate to one party at random and give its owner a fair bit. Condition on the other owners. Each transcript probability factors across parties, so the square-root affinity of 00 with 11 equals that of 01 with 10. Testing the output forces total variation at least the coordinate gap. The triangle inequality through 00 and the entropy bound for a fair bit charge at least gap squared over 16 nats. Sum over independent bits conditional on owners. Shared randomness is independent of inputs. Each partition has T cells. Gate-price companions cannot exist for a count of rectangles.

changed.title: One batch of linear images certifies exact recovery of dense hidden binary constraints with a short random seed
changed.statement:
∀ (n s : ℕ), 3 ≤ s → s ≤ n →
  let W := Fin n → Bool
  let Lit := Fin n × Bool
  let F := Finset (Lit × Lit)
  let sat := fun (C : F) (w : W) => decide (∀ c ∈ C,
    w c.1.1 ≠ c.1.2 ∨ w c.2.1 ≠ c.2.2)
  let high := fun (C : F) =>
    2 ^ n * (2 ^ (s - 1) + 1) ≤
      2 ^ s * (Finset.univ.filter (fun word => sat C word = true)).card
  let L := Nat.clog 2 (n + 1)
  let a := 16 * (1 + 4 * (1 + L))
  let T := 8 + Nat.clog 2 (n - s + 1)
  let M := 2 ^ Nat.clog 2 (4 + (s + 4) * (1 + L))
  let V := Fin (s + 2) → Bool
  ∃ (cal : Fin a → W) (row : Fin M → Fin T → Fin n → V)
    (report : Fin M → (Fin a → Bool) → (Fin T → V → Bool) → Option F),
    ∀ C : F,
      let result := fun seed : Fin M =>
        report seed (fun slot => sat C (cal slot)) (fun block input => sat C (fun bit =>
          (∑ l : Fin (s + 2), ((row seed block bit l) && input l).toNat) % 2 == 1))
      (∀ trial B, result trial = some B → high C ∧ ∀ z, sat B z = sat C z) ∧
      (high C → 3 * M ≤ 4 * (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun u : Fin M => (result u).isSome = true)).card)
changed.unlocks: bounds the queries and random seed needed for certified recovery of dense hidden binary constraints in one fixed batch
changed.context: Calibrate the literal half with a strength-four pool. On its other side retain the coordinates constant on positive examples. Certify each retained bit by a negative matching all the other retained bits. A random linear image surjective on the center and leaves supplies every such test together. Surjectivity also on a free bit exhibits both signs. Union bound over free bits and repeat independent images. Sample a short menu of batches and union bound over the signed stars and disjoint clause pairs above the cutoff. All reports retain their certificates.

changed.title: The 5 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 12059857 is represented on the one-a-side promise by an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 9 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 9 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 5 => (12059857 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) C
changed.unlocks: A saving of at least two gates under this side-5 graph's checked AND/OR floor of 11, one below a checked circuit with NOT gates of 10.
changed.sketch: We hold no circuit of 9 gates; this is a search. A circuit of at most 10 gates with NOT gates for this graph is a checked row. We see no class of equal rows or columns here and no single line whose negation would pay; a yes would be a kind of saving we have not seen. Give a gate list of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in two, at most 9 gates, judged by evaluation on the 25 promise inputs. An exhausted search is a report, not a proof.

changed.title: A fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit outputs resolution refutations of cyclic tables using the number of reachable boundary pairs
changed.statement:
∀ (n w K : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), w ≤ n → 2 ^ w ≤ K → K ≤ 4 ^ w →
  let I := n * 2 ^ (w + 1)
  let S := (3 * (n - w) + 2) * K
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (enable : Fin S → ℕ)
    (memberWire : Fin S → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Literal (Fin n) → ℕ),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack I C ∧
    C.size ≤ 262144 * (n + 1) ^ 4 * K ∧ C.output < I + C.size ∧
    (∀ slot, enable slot < I + C.size) ∧
    (∀ slot lit, memberWire slot lit < I + C.size) ∧
    ∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let pos := fun (v : ℕ) => (⟨v % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
      let reached := fun (h : ℕ) =>
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Bool)).filter (fun word =>
          ∀ t : Fin h, table (pos t.val)
            (fun j => word (pos (t.val + j.val))) = true)).image
          (fun x => ((fun a : Fin w => x (pos a.val)),
                     (fun z : Fin w => x (pos (h + z.val)))))
      (∀ h ≤ n - w, (reached h).card ≤ K) →
      let inputs := List.ofFn (fun a : Fin I =>
        table (pos (a.val / 2 ^ (w + 1))) (fun bit => a.val.testBit bit.val))
      let F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)) :=
        {D | ∃ (i : Fin n) (p : Fin (w + 1) → Bool), table i p = false ∧
          D = Finset.univ.image (fun k : Fin (w + 1) => (pos (i.val + k.val), !(p k)))}
      let wireVal := fun wire : ℕ => (C.wires inputs).getD wire false
      let lines := ((List.finRange S).filter (fun s => wireVal (enable s))).map
        (fun s => Finset.univ.filter (fun lit => wireVal (memberWire s lit) = true))
      (C.eval inputs = true ↔ ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable F) ∧
        (C.eval inputs = true → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsRefutation F lines ∧
          ∀ D ∈ lines, D.card ≤ 2 * w + 1)
changed.unlocks: bounds the gate cost and resolution slots needed to refute a cyclic table under the distinct-pair promise
changed.context: Start with equal windows. Batch-read both extensions of K pairs. Sort valid children by pair, mark one per group, and pack the marks with a second sort. Save both sets of switches. Test wrapping rows on final pairs. Going backward, undo packing, copy each representative clause to its duplicates, then undo the initial sort. Forbidden branches supply axioms. Forward a clause omitting the pivot or resolve. Join seed clauses likewise. Emit resolvents before premises. Charge three slots per pair and row, one per terminal pair and fewer than 2^w seed joins.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 34940 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 8 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 5) => (34940 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 8
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 5 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 9 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out and equal gates merged); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 8; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 8 (on paper), a gap of 1. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 8 right, gate j writes wire 9 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 20 inputs with one vertex on each side.

changed.title: Rectangles: the 0-entries of a 25 by 30 0/1 matrix (rows in the sentence) are covered by at most 15 all-0 rectangles
changed.unlocks: one entry on how few one-colour rectangles cover the 0-entries or 1-entries of a named small matrix (plane incidence, inner product, a graph's complement): the cover number that communication bounds rest on
changed.context: SKETCH: truth not known to us; the opposite row is offered beside it. Proved by exhibiting the rectangles: a list of pairs (set of rows, set of columns), each all of the one colour, that together contain every entry of that colour; checked by evaluation over the matrix given in the sentence. Our best cover has one rectangle more than this row allows (computed, not checked), found by search and not by exhaustion. Size: minutes if such a cover exists. No sorry, no new axiom.
